items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I had a room I rented from Mike Kanan and his wife Stephanie... he’d say, “Do you want to play?” And I’d, “Yeah.” And he’d get on the phone and an hour later we’re in the studio playing

ctx.x: Okay. Before we leave that I just looked to my left here and amongst the people I see you’ve played with if this is correct is a drummer named Jimmy Wormworth.

Well yeah, I met Jimmy in New York through Mike Kanan which actually came through Jorge Rossi. I had a short period, five or six years, where I was going back to New York about every six weeks I would go for ten days. I had a room I rented from Mike Kanan and his wife Stephanie. And I was doing a lot of work and I began to turn down some work because all I wanted to do was play with those guys, you know, and Mike had a studio and so I was playing — I would get to New York about 6 or 7 the plane would come in at…

Play for your supper. I mentioned Jimmy Wormworth because he’s from Utica where I am, and he is a well known local figure. I found on the internet the video, and I wonder if you remember this, it came from 1987 from the Guitar Institute and you’re playing with Ed Thigpen and Ron — a guitar player Ron?
